key.name: source
key.description: "wallpaper": the seed is the wallpaper's main colour (vibeos-theme --wallpaper sets it when the wallpaper changes); "preset": the seed was picked by hand.

key.name: seed
key.description: Every colour of the theme is computed from it. The default teal gives the colours the VibeOS apps were drawn in before they had a theme.

key.name: style
contrast
key.summary: Contrast level: 0 standard, 0.5 medium, 1 high (below 0, less than standard)

key.name: pure-black
key.summary: In dark mode, black backgrounds instead of the scheme's near-black

key.name: light-roles
key.summary: The light scheme: each role's colour (0xAARRGGBB) by its name ("primary", "on_surface", ...)

key.name: light-palettes
key.summary: The tonal palettes in light mode: "accent1", "accent2", "accent3", "neutral1", "neutral2" and "error", each the colours of stops 0, 10, 50, 100, 200 ... 900 and 1000 (tones 100, 99, 95, 90, 80 ... 10 and 0)

key.name: dark-palettes
key.summary: The tonal palettes in dark mode, as light-palettes (the primary palette is less colourful in dark)
